# HttpProtect.connect() method

Opens a Redis connection and adopts it as this instance's client.

**Signature:**

```typescript
connect(options?: RedisOptions): Redis;
```

## Parameters

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Redis

The newly created client, which is also stored on this instance.

## Remarks

Called by the constructor when no client was supplied. Calling it again replaces the current client without disconnecting the old one, so a repeat call leaks a connection — use it to reconnect after [HttpProtect.destroy()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.destroy/)<!-- -->, not to reconfigure a live instance.
